page.overview:
What is Superweapon?

Superweapons or megaweapons were weapons of extremely devastating power, ranging from the capacity to destroy a city to entire planets.

A superweapon (also spelled super-weapon) or megaweapon referred to a weapon of great power, capable of bringing varying degrees of massive destruction. Some may level whole cities and continents, whilst some could even destroy planets.

A type of superweapon was the superlaser, which were laser-based superweapons. These weapons often required large power-sources, such as the first Death Star, which took massive amounts of Kyber crystals to fire.

An ancient walker and a superweapon created by the culture of the Ancients eons before the founding of the Jedi Order was a massive, four-legged vehicle, armed with a head-mounted energy weapon capable of significant amounts of destruction.
